name: Teysa Karlov
blurb: Aristocrats: sacrifice expendable creatures, double death triggers, drain life and rebuild your board.

name: Breya, Etherium Shaper
blurb: Artifact engine: build Thopters, recycle artifacts and turn expendable machines into damage and control. No Voltron plan.

name: Eriette of the Charmed Apple
blurb: Aura control: charm opposing creatures so they cannot attack you; each Aura fuels your end-step life drain.

name: Aragorn, the Uniter
blurb: Four colours, four triggers: white spells raise Human Soldiers, blue spells scry, red spells burn the opponent for 3 and green spells pump +4/+4 - so every gold spell fires several at once.

name: Atraxa, Praetors' Voice
blurb: Proliferate every end step to grow +1/+1 counters, planeswalker loyalty and poison until the opponent buckles under ever-growing counters.

name: Hearthhull, the Worldseed
blurb: Jund lands-sacrifice: station the Worldseed with big creatures, sacrifice fetches and lands to draw two and replay them from the graveyard, then fly in while every sacrificed land drains the opponent for 2.

cards.n: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath

name: Kaalia of the Vast
blurb: Mardu cheat-into-play: swing with Kaalia and drop Angels, Demons and Dragons from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking, so their enter triggers wreck the board before the opponent can answer.

name: Lathril, Blade of the Elves
blurb: Elf tribal: flood the board with Elves and Elf Warrior tokens, drain the opponent and tap ten Elves to finish with a 10-point life swing.

cards.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
blurb: Sultai graveyard value: mill yourself, then replay a land and recast a creature, artifact, enchantment and planeswalker from your graveyard every single turn.

name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER
blurb: Mono-black aristocrats: Sephiroth sacrifices your fodder to draw cards, drains for every creature that dies and becomes the One-Winged Angel after the fourth death in a turn.

cards.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
